InstructionIdentification.name: Instruction Identification
InstructionIdentification.definition: Identification of the original meeting instruction message for which the global status or the status(es) of one or more individual instructions are provided.

InstructionCancellationIdentification.name: Instruction Cancellation Identification
InstructionCancellationIdentification.definition: Identification of the original meeting instruction cancellation request message for which the global status or the status(es) of one or more individual instruction cancellation requests are provided.
